mapper.sql: rate_date, usd_krw, source, is_substituted, substituted_from, collected_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fx_rates WHERE rate_date < #{rateDate} AND rate_date >= DATE_SUB(#{rateDate}, INTERVAL #{lookbackDays} DAY) ORDER BY rate_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO fx_rates (rate_date, usd_krw, source, is_substituted, substituted_from, collected_at) VALUES (#{rateDate}, #{usdKrw}, #{source}, #{substituted}, #{substitutedFrom}, #{collectedAt})
